title: Player checks in at the kiosk
description: At the club check-in kiosk, a member finds their name (by typing), enters their score PIN, and joins today’s attendance.

steps.title: Check-in kiosk
steps.body: The front desk leaves the Players list in check-in kiosk mode. Members use the Check-in control on their row — not a personal login.

steps.title: Find your name
steps.body: You can scroll the roster to find Eden Brooks, but it is more efficient to start typing in the name search.
steps.actionHint: Type in the name search field

steps.title: Your row appears
steps.body: Typing part of the name narrows the list. Eden Brooks has an active visit pack and is not present yet, so their row shows Check-in.
steps.resultNote: Name filter matches the member; Check-in is ready.

steps.title: Start check-in
steps.body: Tap Check-in on your row. The kiosk asks for your score PIN (not your login password).

steps.title: Enter PIN and confirm
steps.body: Type the PIN, then confirm Check-in. A correct PIN records attendance for today.
steps.actionHint: Click Check-in after entering the PIN

steps.title: State updated
steps.body: The row has changed: Check-in is gone and Check-out appears. The attendance count increases, and a visit-pack remaining visit decreases when this was a charged check-in.
steps.resultNote: Member is present; kiosk row now offers Check-out.
